provenance.notes: Datasheet: Taiwan Alpha Electronic '16mm Rotary Type, Metal Shaft Series' (6 pages), model RV16AF-20 (single unit, horizontal terminals, metal bushing). Specification table p.1: total rotational angle 300±5°, maximum operating voltage 150 V AC. Outline drawing for RV16AF-20, p.3: three terminals 1.0 wide x 0.5 thick on a 5 + 5 mm pitch (PCB holes 3 x ø1.2 at 5 mm), 3.5 mm of terminal below the body, shaft axis 12.5 mm above the terminal shoulder, front ø17, body ø16.5, depth 9.1 mm, bushing M7x0.75 x 6.5, shaft ø6. The circuit drawing shows the wiper on terminal 2 (centre). Rated power 0.2 W for linear taper (0.05 W log) comes from the Conrad-hosted Alpha RV16A-20 sheet (Potentiometer-Service GmbH), which also gives shaft Ø6 x L 15 mm and 300° ± 5; the Alpha sheet itself has no power rating and no resistance tolerance. Pin pitch: 5.0 mm is 1.97 pitches, so the terminals map to a 2-pitch stride at [0,0], [2,0], [4,0] (0.08 mm off the grid, taken up by the bendable terminals). Kit: the component list reads 'Potentiometer (10k) x1'; SunFounder 2.1.3 says terminals 1 and 3 are the ends of the 10 kΩ track and terminal 2 is the moving contact. The kit photo shows a 3-terminal pot on an orange base in the common WH148/RV16 style, but SunFounder names no model, so the Alpha RV16AF-20 numbers are a documented stand-in. The 5 mm pitch, 300° travel and linear taper are verified for the Alpha part and are assumptions for the kit's actual pot. bodyMm is [front width along the terminal row, depth from rear of body to shaft tip (9.1 + 15), shaft-axis height + body radius (12.5 + 8.25)].
